answer: Locks are recorded in quill, expire in cedar, and ember lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 92 aliases therefore needs 172 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4968 identities would post 4409 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
